apps.name: Beacon Finance
apps.whats_new:
48.20.0  (November 2026)  THE PASTOR CHOOSES THE FINANCE ROLES; SECURITY RULES 53
  The Disbursing Officers, Treasurers, Approvers and Auditors are chosen by the pastor in Beacon Pastor on the phone → Roles
  (Website Update 100). This book takes them at Save and Publish, when Slips from the Portal opens and every 10 minutes while
  signed in, and writes it in the audit log. In Portal Finance Roles those lists show "set by the pastor" and cannot be
  changed; the name on the voucher and the signatures are still set here. A list the pastor has not saved stays as it is.
  Online Giving → Copy Security Rules / Make Giving Page Files give rules version 53.

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.40.0 - THE PASTOR CHOOSES THE ROLES (and Website Update 100, rules 53)
  - The pastor chooses the roles in ONE place: Beacon Pastor on the phone → Roles (the lead pastor's own app, /pastor/).
    This program takes his lists at every sync: Officer: Admin, Officer: Secretary, Church leaders and officers, others who
    may post to everyone, who sees the Members directory, who sees all meetings, who takes the attendance of each kind of
    meeting, and the ministry leaders (Leads). Here they show "Set by the pastor" and cannot be changed (Leaders and
    officers…, Meetings… → Setup, Edit Member → Leads / Church leader). The lead pastor is still chosen here. A list the
    pastor has not saved yet stays as it is here.
  - This program's copy of the portal page and the rules: Website Update 100 (rules version 53), with Beacon Pastor on the
    phone (/pastor/).

apps.name: Beacon Admin
apps.whats_new: NEW IN 1.29.0: THE PASTOR CHOOSES THE ROLES - Who is in Beacon Admin on the phone, who is told of replies to assignments, and the Music Leader(s) are chosen by the pastor in ONE place (Beacon Pastor on the phone → Roles). This program takes his lists at every sync (every 2 minutes while signed in) and shows them as "set by the pastor": they cannot be changed here. A list the pastor has not saved yet stays as it is here. Needs Website Update 100 (rules 53).
